query: 网络安全风险治理 网络安全风险治理 网络安全风险治理 定性 衡量董事会与管理层对网络安全的治理、防护和响应能力。 2分 全面披露且治理闭环：同时满足以下三项：（1）董事会/专门委员会对网络安全承担监督职责；（2）制定网络安全制度并获外部认证（如ISO 27001、等保三级）；（3）披露安全事件应急响应机制及演练情况 企业管治报告/ESG报告中有明确描述，且三项均具备 1分 部分披露或制度不完整：满足上述2分标准中的任意1-2项，或在ESG报告中仅作原则性陈述（如仅声明“重视网络安全”但无具体制度名称、无董事会职责描述、无认证信息） 有相关披露但内容不完整，缺乏可验证的具体信息 0分 未披露或仅形式披露：ESG报告中未涉及网络安全治理内容，或仅以“本公司重视信息安全”等笼统表述一笔带过，无任何实质性信息 无法从公开披露中获取有效信息 注意，本指标虽采用0-2分定性评分制，但为捕捉企业“报喜不报忧”的披露偏差，引入负面事件减分触发机制：若外部信息检索发现以下严重事件，评分结果在原有基础上降一级（2分→1分，1分→0分）： 事件类型 判定标准 信息来源 重大数据泄露事件 报告期内发生涉及用户/客户敏感信息的泄露事件，受影响记录超过10万条或遭监管处罚 隐私事务专员公署通报、媒体报导 监管处罚/整改令 因网络安全/数据保护违规收到监管机构行政处罚、公开谴责或整改令 证监会/联交所公告、工信部/网信办通报 重大勒索软件攻击 报告期内遭受勒索软件攻击导致核心业务中断超过24小时 公司公告、主流财经媒体报导 注：若企业已在ESG报告中主动披露上述事件，并详细说明整改措施与防范机制改进，可不触发降级（体现对主动披露的激励）。 网络安全治理 董事会网络安全监督 信息安全制度 等级保护 应急响应 灾备演练 网络风险管理委员会 数据泄露 敏感信息泄露 网络安全处罚 数据保护处罚 整改令 勒索软件 业务中断 主动披露 整改措施 防范机制改进 ISO 27001 等保三级 cybersecurity governance board oversight of cybersecurity information security policy ISO 27001 incident response disaster recovery drill data breach sensitive records cybersecurity penalty data protection enforcement remediation order ransomware business interruption proactive disclosure remediation measures preventive improvements 董事会或专门委员会是否承担网络安全监督？ 是否制定制度并取得ISO 27001、等保三级等认证？ 是否披露应急响应及演练？ 报告期内是否发生超过10万条敏感记录泄露、监管处罚/整改令或核心业务中断超过24小时的勒索攻击？ 事件来源、日期、记录数或中断时长是什么？ 企业是否主动披露并说明整改与防范改进？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '网络安全风险治理'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 董事会或专门委员会是否承担网络安全监督？ 是否制定制度并取得ISO 27001、等保三级等认证？ 是否披露应急响应及演练？ 报告期内是否发生超过10万条敏感记录泄露、监管处罚/整改令或核心业务中断超过24小时的勒索攻击？ 事件来源、日期、记录数或中断时长是什么？ 企业是否主动披露并说明整改与防范改进？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅称重视信息安全；仅有隐私政策；仅有防火墙等运营技术而无治理要素；未经可靠来源确认、非报告期或非集团事件。区分：本项初评治理监督并核验外部负面事件；第30项关注运营防护。外部事件只触发原口径降级，不替代治理初评。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: Impro Group has always been committed to ensuring a high standard of corporate governance and continues reviewing and improving corporate internal controls. We have strictly complied with the principles and code provisions of the Corporate Governance Code and Corporate Governance Report (the 'CG Code') as set out in Appendix 14 to the Rules Governing the Listing of Securities on the Stock Exchange. The Board has established the Audit Committee, the Remuneration Committee, the Nomination Committee and the Sustainability Committee. The responsibilities of each committee are clearly divided and coordinated. By formulating business plans and development strategies, discovering new opportunities and overcoming new market challenges, identifying and paying attention to potential risks, and formulating the strategic framework for sustainable development, the committees have jointly safeguarded the corporate and social responsibilities and values of the Group. Board diversity is also one of the elements of the Group's long-term development. The Board has reviewed the diversity policy, and comprehensively considered the candidates of directors in terms of gender, age, cultural and educational background, industry experience, technical and professional skills and/or qualifications, knowledge, length of service and time devoted to performing the duties of directors when designing, reviewing and evaluating the composition of the Board. Currently, female members of the Board account for 25%.

results.text: In 2020, the Group formally established the Sustainability Committee to carry out planning, risk identification and assessment on ESG matters. In 2020, the Group formally established the Sustainability Committee to carry out planning, risk identification and assessment on ESG matters. The committee, which includes 2 independent non-executive directors and 3 executive directors, regularly convenes committee meetings with the management and external consultants of the Group to ensure that the management and all employees are involved in and engaged in the Group's sustainability management. We carry out the Group's comprehensive sustainability management with a sustainable development hierarchy to ensure that the management and frontline employees identify the Group's ESG responsibilities, and voluntarily participate in ESG management, so as to jointly realize the Group's sustainable development vision.
